whole_source_findings: Sentiment is computed but never reaches the LLM, while prompts demand positive/negative/neutral percentages and per-platform counts as 'real data': high fabrication risk
search_topic_by_date parses its dates and never filters by them; cluster sampling ranks by a hotness that is always zero for topic search
The Qwen3 LoRA classifier reports a fixed 0.8 confidence and labels unparseable output negative; 'BertChinese-Lora' is an off-the-shelf model
Report claims are not traceable: engine reports enter as plain text, footnotes and xrefs are never rendered, chart repairs pad and truncate series, density gates push length, forecasts are prose
An LLM forum host's 'trend forecasts' are injected into every agent's prompts; the host prompt asserts an unverified ethics review

MindSpider/DeepSentimentCrawling/MediaCr.method: blob comparison against the reviewed commit; the modified and old-only files read as a semantic diff by a read-only review; the old window.mnsv2 signer spot-checked
findings: The old version harvests and stores creator profiles (gender, signature, avatar, IP location, follows and fans, tags) on all seven platforms, a Bilibili follower/following graph, and raw user ids, nicknames and IP locations on posts and comments; the reviewed version pseudonymises and dropped creator storage
Xiaohongshu requests are signed by calling the page's own window.mnsv2 and building x-s-common locally; Douyin user-post requests carry a hard-coded verifyFp/fp device fingerprint
Tieba is read by driving real page navigation and scraping rendered HTML
